about: SHA-256 pins for build downloads that publish no checksums of their own. The ripgrep binaries come from github.com/microsoft/ripgrep-prebuilt release v15.0.1, the version @vscode/ripgrep 1.17.1 (VS Code 1.142.0) downloads, recorded on 2026-10-16. build.mjs fails on a mismatch, and on a missing pin when FRIEDLIVER_REQUIRE_PINS is set (release builds). After an upstream bump that changes @vscode/ripgrep, add the new files' hashes here.
